jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 26e (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/autotune.mjs, tools/budgets-commands.mjs, tools/inbox-commands.mjs, tools/managers/lessons/close.mjs, tools/plan-commands.mjs, tools/remote.mjs, tools/swarm/core-32.mjs, tools/tool-config.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/swarm/train3). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/autotune.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/autotune.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 157 `} catch { /* fall through */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT/EACCES — reading /proc/meminfo is a best-effort Linux-only probe that already falls back to os.freemem() on failure.

### tools/budgets-commands.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/budgets-commands.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 40 `readLedger(root).catch(() => null)`: SILENT-ENOENT — no ledger yet is fine for a status display, but readLedger rethrows raw SyntaxError on corruption so that case must be logged as fixed text 'corrupt ledger (SyntaxError)', not the raw message.

### tools/inbox-commands.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/inbox-commands.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 64 `fs.access(entry/.swarm) catch { /* not a swarm project */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT/ENOTDIR — probes a registered project path for a .swarm directory when listing `--all` roots; a registered folder simply not being (or no longer being) a swarm project is expected.

### tools/managers/lessons/close.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/managers/lessons/close.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 218 `const text = await readCappedRepoFile(root, rel)`: SILENT-ENOENT — probing multiple landed-path candidates where most are expected not to exist; log any other code (e.g. lesson-close-path, lesson-close-too-large) since those mean a real bug or oversize artifact.

### tools/plan-commands.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/plan-commands.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 74 `await writeCalibration(root, recordActual(calibration, ...))`: LOG-ALWAYS — readCalibration/writeCalibration already swallow their own ENOENT/corrupt-JSON cases internally, so anything reaching this outer catch is unexpected and should be logged even though calibration itself stays best-effort.

### tools/remote.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/remote.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 91 `try { await fs.access(p, 1); return p } catch { /* next */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT/EACCES/ENOTDIR — PATH probe for the tailscale binary; log anything else.

### tools/swarm/core-32.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/swarm/core-32.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 55 `const info = await fs.stat(await safePath(root, file))`: SILENT-ENOENT — sizing a job's declared outputs against the output cap; an output not yet written has no size, which is expected, log anything else (e.g. a safePath/security error).

### tools/tool-config.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/tool-config.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 44 `for (const entry of readdirSync(root, {withFileTypes:true}))`: SILENT-ENOENT/EACCES/ENOTDIR — shallow disk probe for config files, used only when the project isn't a clean git repo; treating an unreadable root as 'missing' matches the function's own doc comment, log anything else.

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
